reads.note: Full file read. Dominator-layer facts, replay after cloning, switch/branch/select folding, guarded trap/deopt behavior, small-block threading and return duplication. Existing arbitrary-carrier control_choice_templates already cover repeated branches; consolidate duplicate word instances rather than counting these as new generalization. Further control equivalences require ordinary Cases proofs; clone budgets are search policy.
Full file read: singleton word constants and exact FP constants; NaN payload and minus-zero caveats. Compare general known-value proposal/checking, not speculative assumptions.
Full file read: current reducer is a speculation-test hook, not a loop optimization implementation. Continue peeling/unrolling and older loop machinery.
Full file read: allocation-use collection and fixed-point removal of nonescaping allocation/store chains. Compare owned-buffer and collect-before-build proofs; no new authority admitted.

Full file read. Tagged/untagged cancellation, exact conversion constants, object-kind checks and overflow/minus-zero check removal. Ink has fixed carriers rather than JS maps/oddballs; seven total U32/U64 conversion laws independently checked in staging, multiplication-narrowing unadmitted.
Full file read. API and use-list/worklist state for the already-read allocation remover; broader escape/physical representation assessment remains.

Full file read. Static canonical loop matching, bounded exact simulation and conservative overflow bailout; approximate counts are heuristics, not proof. Ink stages exact literal-count expansions through existing Normalize proofs rather than copying approximate assumptions.

Full file read. Peel innermost bounded-size loops, remap loop phis/backedges and retain separate peeling/unrolling phases; skip unavailable second iteration. General database literal-loop expansions checked on U32, U64 and List<U32>; broader dynamic peeling and profitability remain open.

Full file read. Exact versus approximate iteration counts, loop/function/code-size budgets, partial body cloning with per-copy exit checks, Phi snapshot repair and variable-allocation bailout. Exact literal repeat proposals are now independently checked for arbitrary source carriers. Dynamic partial unrolling and peeling need separately checked identities and profitability evidence; V8 thresholds are not imported as authority.

Full file read. Exact equality after hashing, dominance-scoped tables, same-block Phi restriction, mutation epochs, conservative loop invalidation, GC-sensitive map-load exclusion and ordered rehashing. Generic database scalar-sharing producer inserts existing lexical bindings; scoped/captured source instances independently replayed. Stateful memory/value numbering remains open.

Full file read. Backwards live-operation/control lattice, required effects, joins, loop fixed-point revisits, branch redirection and leaf stack-check facts. Pure lexical dead-value proposals need checker evidence; stateful effects, observations, failures and interrupts cannot be erased from source observations.

Full file read. Exact base/offset/size shadowing, conservative read aliasing, observable/GC-observable lattice and joins, loop-local fresh-base invalidation, fixed-point revisits and adjacent initializing store merge with pointer/endianness restrictions. Compare existing whole-action replace_overwrite proof; broader effects/transaction assessment remains open.
